notes.1.1: A letter to a dead wife. Line 2: pꜣ=t ḫpr, 'your bringing about', is uncertain; the clause is literally 'your becoming in this evil state in which I am'.

nodes.text: What wrong have I done against you, that you have brought about this evil state that I am in?
What have I done against you?
What you have done is to lay hands on me, though I had done no wrong against you.
